why: The interface was renamed by hand: types.ts declares Pet and roster.ts's annotation says Pet[], but roster.ts's first line is still 'import type { Animal } from './types''. tsc: TS2305 (no exported member 'Animal') and TS2304 (cannot find name 'Pet'). The type-only import is as stale as a value import would be.

step.title: Rename Animal to Pet
step.instructions: In src/types.ts, put the cursor on Animal, press F2, type Pet and press Enter. VS Code renames the interface and every use of it, in src/roster.ts too. Then run npx tsc.

checks.label: roster.ts types the roster as Pet[]

hints: F2 renames a symbol in every file that uses it, import lines included.
common_mistakes: Renaming the interface by hand and leaving the old name in an import line.
